summary: Execute a linked GitHub issue with repository-aware delivery

delivery.outcome: Execute one GitHub issue using Planfile, canonical repository-aware isolation, required tests and the declared protected publication route.
nonGoals: No hardware output activation or firmware flashing
No branch or PR in main-only repositories
No merge without independent Validator evidence

architecture.decision: One scoped URL intake; use Planfile for ticket/comments, a local trusted repository profile for effects, Wellmanifest for worktree placement, and existing OneDev/Validator adapters for protected delivery. Private execution receipts are operational working data; no existing product schema, stored records or ownership is migrated.
architecture.rollback: Revert material implementation; preserve outstanding receipts and worktrees.

commands: python -m ruff check src/koru/cli_ticket.py src/koru/ticket_command tests/test_ticket_command*.py
validation.evidence: Focused tests, governance and protected delivery receipts
